data.exact_reserve_text: In 2017, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 1.8m on prior year reserves (2016:surplus GBP 0.7m). This has been primarily generated by the reduction in premium on casualty reinsurance class of business.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 54.925m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development triangle, prior-year development on older underwriting years (<=2015) produced a small net adverse movement of approximately GBP 0.44m (c.0.8% of opening gross reserves), i.e. a slight strengthening of gross reserves. The managing agent however reports a net prior-year deficit of GBP 1.8m (2016: a net surplus of GBP 0.7m) which is stated to have been primarily driven by a reduction in premium on the casualty reinsurance class. Current year catastrophe activity (HIM: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California wildfires) materially impacted 2017 results but is largely protected by reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit aggregate GROSS prior-year movement figure was provided by the syndicate. The managing agent narrative quotes a net prior-year deficit of GBP 1.8m (net of reinsurance). Per the extraction rules a gross PYD was computed from the gross claims development triangle (see _claims_triangle). The triangle figures are presented in GBP '000 in the report; the PYD above is derived from those gross triangle values. Where narrative amounts are in USD (e.g. $10.4m net HIM exposure) they were not converted.
